name: KTM Freeride 250 / 350
engine: 249 cc two-stroke or 349 cc four-stroke single, liquid-cooled
intro: KTM's light trail and trials-style bikes. Low seat, light weight, two-stroke or four-stroke depending on the model.

B: The Freeride 250 R is a two-stroke that runs premix. The 250 F and 350 are four-strokes. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a KTM dealer to run the VIN as well.
